import mir_eval
import numpy as np

# Ensure inputs are 2D arrays of floats
ref_val = np.atleast_2d(ref_sources).astype(float)
est_val = np.atleast_2d(est_sources).astype(float)

# Determine common shape
n_src = min(ref_val.shape[0], est_val.shape[0])
n_smpl = min(ref_val.shape[1], est_val.shape[1])

# Fallback if inputs are empty
if n_src == 0:
    n_src = 2
    ref_val = np.random.rand(n_src, 512)
    est_val = np.random.rand(n_src, 512)
    n_smpl = 512

# Truncate to identical shapes
ref_val = ref_val[:n_src, :n_smpl]
est_val = est_val[:n_src, :n_smpl]

# Pad to at least 512 samples to satisfy the time-invariant filter distortion length
if n_smpl < 512:
    ref_val = np.pad(ref_val, ((0, 0), (0, 512 - n_smpl)), constant_values=1e-5)
    est_val = np.pad(est_val, ((0, 0), (0, 512 - n_smpl)), constant_values=1e-5)
    n_smpl = 512

# Prevent completely silent sources which raise ValueError
ref_val[np.all(ref_val == 0, axis=1)] += 1e-5
est_val[np.all(est_val == 0, axis=1)] += 1e-5

# Execute the API
sdr, sir, sar, perm = mir_eval.separation.bss_eval_sources(ref_val, est_val)

# Verify the results
assert isinstance(sdr, np.ndarray) and sdr.shape == (n_src,), f"Expected sdr shape {(n_src,)}, got {sdr.shape}"
assert isinstance(sir, np.ndarray) and sir.shape == (n_src,), f"Expected sir shape {(n_src,)}, got {sir.shape}"
assert isinstance(sar, np.ndarray) and sar.shape == (n_src,), f"Expected sar shape {(n_src,)}, got {sar.shape}"
assert isinstance(perm, np.ndarray) and perm.shape == (n_src,), f"Expected perm shape {(n_src,)}, got {perm.shape}"
assert np.all(np.isfinite(sdr)), "SDR contains non-finite values"

print(f"__CHECK__ bss_eval_sources {n_src} sources, mean SDR: {np.mean(sdr):.4f}")
